lines.text: Many learners say: I am agree with you.
Agree is already a verb. Do not add am.

data.why: Agree is already a verb. Do not add am.

native.hook: agree ไม่ต้องมี am!

en.tip: Agree is already a verb, so you do not need “am”: “I agree”
en.caption: Do you say “I am agree with you”? 😅 Agree is already a verb, so it does not need am. Say “I agree with you”! Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
